framework (259-FZ + subsequent amendments). No measured
Russian off-ramp shock attributable to the 2022-01-20
consultation publication itself has been pinned in this
authoring pass. Marked not_measured with a coverage_gap
observation row below; this is the null_event-shaped
empirical posture flagged in the task brief.

coverage row is partially_measured because the policy lever

attributable specifically to this regional decision (versus
ongoing Russia-wide mining licensing changes under the 2024
Federal Law on Mining and other concurrent regulatory moves)
has not been quantitatively re-verified in this authoring
pass. The load-bearing observation row below is recorded as
observed_change with attribution=plausible accordingly.

Load-bearing layer. All Mt. Gox on/off-ramps (BTC, JPY, USD, EUR)
permanently ceased on 2014-02-28 when Mt. Gox filed for civil
rehabilitation at the Tokyo District Court. The operator's own
announcement and Karpeles's same-day news conference at the court
directly attest the cessation. Best-documented exchange collapse
of the 2013-2016 tier; ~70% peak market share makes this the
single largest CEX off-ramp closure of the era.

  - 1 address frozen 2025-05-08 10:21 UTC (likely late-arrival from the May batch)

cluster 6 months before OFAC made it public (the Apr 30 / May 8 2025 batches), and
the remainder was swept on OFAC designation day with a ~21-hour delay. This is
consistent with Tether operating on BOTH (a) upstream compliance intelligence for
some addresses and (b) reactive OFAC-following for the remainder.

The 2017-09 PBOC-led instruction is by construction an off-ramp
/ CNY-rail closure event: it directed the three dominant PRC
domestic exchanges (BTCC, OKCoin, Huobi) to cease all CNY-paired
crypto trading and wind down domestic operations. BTCC announced
cessation of all trading by 2017-09-30; Huobi and OKCoin committed
to ceasing yuan-paired trading by end of October 2017. The
offramp_cex layer carries the load-bearing direct-attribution
observation. Marked measured.
